text: Gangs may spend their credits on equipment from their Equipment Lists for their gangs and purchase items from the Trading Post. Weapons and wargear may always be purchased from a gang's Equipment List, but can only be purchased from the Trading Post if at least one Fighter performed the Visit Trading Post Post-cycle Action.
Exclusive items (those with a TP of E) may only be purchased if they appear on a model's Equipment List.
Each Fighter that performs the Visit Trading Post Post-cycle Action adds Trade Points to the gang: 2 TP if the action is performed by a Leader, 1 TP if it is performed by a Champion.

In order to purchase items from the Trading Post, as well as paying the Credit Cost you must deduct the number of Trade Points for the equipment from the total generated; any unspent Trade Points are lost at the end of this sub-step.

tradingPost.tradePoints: the item's TP, deducted from the Trade Points the gang generated

purchaseRules.exclusive: Items with a TP of E can only be bought from a model's Equipment List, never from the Trading Post.
purchaseRules.unspentTradePoints: lost at the end of the sub-step
related: House rule 10: a gang may buy equipment from its Equipment List at any time.
Tech Bazaar (territory Boon): +1 Trade Point each Post-cycle Sequence, and the gang may always purchase items from the Trading Post.

tradingPost.title: Ranged Weapons
tradingPost.source: Core Rulebook (2026), p154-156, Necromunda's Most Wanted (2026), p66-67

tradingPost.title: Armour
tradingPost.rule: A Fighter may not be equipped with more than one item of armour or field armour, unless the wargear explicitly says it can be combined with other armour or field armour.

tradingPost.title: Field Armour
tradingPost.rule: A Fighter may not be equipped with more than one item of armour or field armour, unless the wargear explicitly says it can be combined with other armour or field armour.

tradingPost.title: Gang Equipment
tradingPost.rule: Unlike other items of wargear, Gang Equipment is placed into the gang's Stash when purchased and may be used from there.

groups.title: Traps (Frag, Gas & Melta)
rules: At the end of the Deployment step of the Pre-battle Sequence after all models have been deployed, either gang may deploy traps on the battlefield. If both gangs wish to deploy them, then the defender deploys theirs first.

In order to deploy a trap, place it anywhere on the battlefield outside of your opponent's deployment zone and at least 6" away from any models. Each trap may only be used once and once it is deployed upon the battlefield it is deleted from the gang's Stash even if it does not detonate.

If any model, friendly or enemy, comes within 2" of a trap for any reason, their movement is interrupted as they risk setting it off. The trap's owner rolls a D6. On a result of 1, the trap is a dud and is removed from the battlefield. On a result of 2 or 3, the trap does not go off but is left in place. On a result of 4+, the trap is triggered and will explode; centre the blast marker on the trap and resolve any Hits before removing the trap from the battlefield. If the model is Seriously Injured/Damaged by the explosion their movement ends and if it was their activation it also ends. Otherwise the model finishes their movement.

Any model can target a trap with ranged attacks with a -1 penalty to the Hit roll. If the trap is Hit, roll a D6: on a 1, it is unaffected; on a 2-3, it is immediately triggered; on a 4-6, it is destroyed and removed from the battlefield.

powers.title: Wyrd Powers: Psychoteric Whispers
powers.intro: The following are Wyrd Powers available to Delaque Fighters. Any Delaque Fighter with the Wyrd Subtype may select Psychoteric Whispers Wyrd Powers as an Advancement as if they were a Primary Skill Set.

items.name: Terrible Truths
items.text: Choose a single enemy Fighter that is within 6" and Line of Sight of the Wyrd. That Fighter must make a Willpower check. If this check is failed, they gain the Insanity Condition.

items.name: Psychotic Lure
items.text: Choose a single enemy Fighter that currently has a Ready marker and is within 6" and Line of Sight of the Wyrd. The opposing player must activate that Fighter next. The chosen Fighter cannot perform the Group Activation action when next activated.

items.name: Deceitful Thoughts
items.text: Choose a single enemy Fighter that is within 6" and Line of Sight of the Wyrd. That Fighter immediately makes a Willpower check. If this check is failed, the Wyrd's controlling player may immediately move that Fighter up to their Movement characteristic in any direction (note: this move may not be used to move enemy Fighters off ledges, into dangerous terrain or any other part of the battlefield harmful to them).

items.name: Cacophony of Silence
items.text: While this power is maintained, all enemy Fighters within 6" and Line of Sight of the Wyrd must re-roll successful Hit rolls when making a ranged attack.

items.name: A Perfect Void
items.text: While this power is maintained, the Wyrd counts as always being in cover and within a weapon's Long Range to all enemy Fighters within 10".

items.name: Eternal Slumber
items.text: Choose a Seriously Injured enemy Fighter within 3" and Line of Sight of the Wyrd, they immediately go Out of Action.

entries.label: Grenade launcher with frag & krak grenades
Ironhead grenade launcher with seismic grenades

augurspex.name: Augurspex
rules: Enemy Fighters may not be set up within 12" of a Fighter with an augurspex as either Reinforcements or using the Infiltrate skill.

beast-lure.name: Beast lure
rules: An Active or Suppressed Fighter equipped with a beast lure may perform the Place Lure action once per battle:

Place Lure (Single): Place a marker representing a Beast's Lair within 1" of the Fighter. From the start of the following round, any Fighter that ends their activation within 3" of the Beast's Lair suffers a Str 4, AP -, L1 Hit.

beast-repellent.name: Beast repellent
rules: A Fighter equipped with beast repellent does not suffer a Hit if they end their activation within 3" of a Beast's Lair.

bio-booster.name: Bio-booster
rules: The first time in each battle that the bearer gains the Injured Condition, reduce the Lethality characteristic of the weapon damaging them by 1. If the Lethality characteristic is now zero, roll 2 Injury dice instead of 1 and the bearer chooses which to apply, the other dice is discarded.

variants.name: Light
rules: Light carapace armour improves a Fighter's Save characteristic by 1. In addition, they reduce their Initiative characteristic by 1.

variants.name: Heavy
rules: Heavy carapace armour improves a Fighter's Save characteristic by 2. In addition, they reduce their Initiative characteristic by 2 and apply a -1 modifier to all Agility tests they make.

cult-icon.name: Cult icon
rules: Unlike other items of wargear, a gang may only purchase a single cult icon. This item must be carried by either a Leader or Champion. When a Fighter that is carrying a cult icon performs the Group Activation action, they may re-roll the Leadership check.

dirt-bike.name: Dirt bike
rules: A Fighter equipped with a dirt bike gains the Mounted Subtype and sets their Movement characteristic to 8". When they perform a Dash action, they add 5" to their Movement characteristic instead of their Initiative.

drop-rig.name: Drop rig
rules: An Active or Suppressed Fighter with a drop rig can perform the Descend action while they are within 1" of the edge of a platform:

Descend (Single): The Fighter makes a move of up to 3" horizontally and up to 12" vertically. Any vertical movement must be downwards, i.e., towards the ground. This action may not be performed by a Mounted Fighter.

exo-suit.name: Exo-suit
rules: The Fighter is immune to the effects of the Rad-phage and Blaze (X) traits.

grapnel-launcher.name: Grapnel launcher
rules: An Active Fighter with a grapnel launcher can perform the Grapnel action:

Grapnel (Double): The Fighter can move up to 12" in a straight line in any direction as long as they end this move on a higher level than they started. This action may not be performed by a Mounted Fighter.

grav-chute.name: Grav chute
rules: If a Fighter with a grav chute falls or jumps down, they never suffer any damage and are never Suppressed.

grav-cutter.name: Grav Cutter
rules: A Fighter equipped with a Grav Cutter gains the Mounted, Agile and Flying Subtypes and sets their Movement characteristic to 7". When they perform a Dash action, they add 5" to their Movement characteristic instead of their Initiative characteristic.

hazard-suit.name: Hazard suit
rules: A Fighter wearing a hazard suit is immune to the Blaze (X+) and Rad-phage traits.

hystrar-pattern-energy-shield.name: 'Hystrar' pattern energy shield
hystrar-pattern-energy-shield.definedIn: House Van Saar – Close Combat Weapons

medicae-kit.name: Medicae kit
rules: If a Fighter with a Medicae kit aids another Fighter's Recovery test, they roll an additional Injury Dice and choose which one to keep.

mesh-armour.name: Mesh armour
rules: A Fighter equipped with mesh armour increases their Save characteristic by 1 when resolving Hits suffered in close combat.

photo-goggles.name: Photo-goggles
rules: A Fighter equipped with photo-goggles increases the value of X in the Visibility (X") rule by 9" and may see through smoke clouds placed as part of the Smoke trait. Additionally, if a Fighter equipped with photo-goggles is hit by a weapon with the Flash trait, they suffer a -2 modifier to their Initiative check to avoid being blinded.

photo-lumens.name: Photo-lumens
rules: Increase the value of X in the Visibility (X") rule by 9" for this Fighter. This Fighter can always be targeted, regardless of the Visibility (X") rule.

psychomancer-s-harness.name: Psychomancer's harness
rules: A Fighter wearing a psychomancer's harness increases their Movement characteristic by 2", this may take the Fighter's Movement characteristic above the maximum. Additionally, when this Fighter climbs, the vertical distance they move is not halved. In other words, they always count as climbing up or down a ladder. A Fighter may not be equipped with both a psychomancer's harness and a servo-harness.

reflec-shroud.name: Reflec shroud
rules: The wearer counts the AP of any Las, Plasma or Melta Weapon as '-' regardless of their actual AP.

refraction-cloak.name: Refraction cloak
rules: When making a ranged attack against a Fighter equipped with a refraction cloak, the Hit roll suffers a -1 penalty to Hit. This is increased to -2 if the Fighter did not move in their previous activation.

refractor-field.name: Refractor field
rules: A refractor field grants its wearer a 5+ Invulnerable Save; however, should a natural 1 be rolled when making the Invulnerable Save then the refractor field is burned out and cannot be used again for the rest of the battle.
A refractor field may be combined with other armour and field armour.

respirator.name: Respirator
rules: When a Fighter equipped with a respirator is hit by a weapon with the Gas trait, they gain a 5+ Invulnerable save against that weapon.

servo-arm-array.name: Servo-arm array
servo-arm-array.definedIn: House Van Saar – Close Combat Weapons

servo-harness-full.name: Servo-harness - full
rules: A Fighter wearing a full servo-harness gains all of the benefits of a partial servo-harness, but without the negative modifiers to their Movement and Initiative characteristics. This item cannot be combined with a servo-claw or any other type of servo-harness.

servo-harness-partial.name: Servo-harness - partial
rules: A Fighter wearing a partial servo-harness gains a +2 modifier to their Strength characteristic and a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic. This may take them above their maximum characteristics but it is not a permanent increase and will be lost should the servo-harness be lost or cease to function for any reason. However, a Fighter wearing a partial servo-harness reduces their Movement and Initiative characteristics by 1. This item cannot be combined with a servo-claw or any other type of servo-harness.

servo-medicae.name: Servo-medicae
rules: An Active Fighter equipped with a servo-medicae may perform the Auto-medicate action:

Auto-medicate (Free): When a Fighter performs this action, target either them or a friendly Active or Suppressed Fighter within 3" and make an Intelligence check for this Fighter. If the check is passed then the targeted Fighter regains 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle.

spider-rig.name: Spider-rig
spider-rig.definedIn: House Van Saar – Close Combat Weapons

stimm-slug-stash.name: Stimm-slug stash
rules: Once per battle, a Fighter equipped with a stimm-slug stash may use it at the start of their activation. Until their next activation increase their Movement, Strength and Toughness characteristics by 2. At the start of their next activation, these effects wear off and the Fighter's controller must roll a D6; on a 2+ nothing happens but on a result of a 1 they suffer a bad reaction to the stimms - they suffer a Str -, AP -, L1 Hit that automatically Wounds with no saves allowed.

svenotar-scout-trike.name: Svenotar Scout Trike
rules: A Fighter equipped with a Svenotar Scout Trike gains the Mounted Subtype and sets their Movement characteristic to 8". When they perform a Dash action, they add 5" to their Movement characteristic instead of their Initiative.
A Svenotar Scout Trike is equipped with a Svenotar autogun and may take either of the following options when added to the gang or during any Post-cycle Sequence:

variants.name: Replace the Svenotar autogun with a Svenotar boltgun
Replace the Svenotar autogun with a Svenotar meltagun

trazior-pattern-sentry-gun.name: Trazior pattern sentry gun
rules: Deployable Platform: If a gang is the defender, they may deploy up to two Trazior pattern sentry guns. Trazior pattern sentry guns are deployed after all gangs have finished deploying all of their models and must be placed along with a control console within 1" of a friendly Fighter. Once placed, a Trazior pattern sentry gun cannot be moved during a battle, though friendly Active or Suppressed Fighters may perform the Retarget action:
Retarget (Single): A Trazior pattern sentry gun within 1" of this Fighter may pivot on the spot to face another direction.

Target Spotted: Trazior pattern sentry guns do not gain Ready markers and cannot perform actions. Each time a model (either friend or foe) ends their activation within the Front Arc of a Trazior pattern sentry gun's weapon and within range, the Trazior pattern sentry gun will perform a Shoot action targeting the active model with a BS of 5+. Trazior pattern sentry guns may react this way multiple times each round.

If a friendly Fighter is within 1" of a Trazior pattern sentry gun's control console then the Trazior pattern sentry gun will not target the controlling gang's models. Enemy models are not able to override the targeting in this manner as they do not possess the access codes.

Overheat!: Trazior pattern sentry guns often run very hot and overheat. Each time a Trazior pattern sentry gun fires, it must use the maximum number of Firepower dice allowed by the Rapid Fire (X) trait and its heat level increases by D3. If the weapon would go Out of Ammo or jam, instead increase the Trazior pattern sentry gun's heat level by an additional D3 for each Out of Ammo result.

At the start of the End phase, each Trazior pattern sentry gun's heat level decreases by D6. If the heat level is still 6 or higher after this reduction, the Trazior pattern sentry gun shuts down and cannot fire until its heat level drops to 0.

Mechanical Platform: A Trazior pattern sentry gun can be targeted as if it was a Vehicle and has a Toughness characteristic of 4, 2 Wounds and a 5+ Save characteristic. If it is reduced to 0 Wounds, a Trazior pattern sentry gun is immediately removed from the battlefield.
Easy Repair: If a Trazior pattern sentry gun is removed from the battlefield, do not delete it from the gang's Stash, it will still be available for future battles.
Equipment: Trazior pattern sentry guns must select one of the following weapons to be equipped with when added to a gang's Stash, this option may not be changed later:

venomous-bite.name: Venomous bite
venomous-bite.definedIn: House Van Saar – Close Combat Weapons

vox-array.name: Vox array
rules: An Active Fighter equipped with a vox array may perform the Group Activation action as a Free action.
